text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. One common method is supervised learning, where a computer learns from training data. This data includes examples with correct answers, so the computer can understand patterns. Using this data, it builds models that can make predictions about new information. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy, which shows how often the model is correct. Good training data usually leads to better models and more accurate results.
